# Archived v1.0.3 workflows

These seven historical standalone v1.0.3 workflow definitions are retained unchanged for reference and recovery. They are outside `.github/workflows`, so GitHub Actions does not automatically discover or execute these archived copies.

Current build, source-audit, and release-dispatch workflows remain in `.github/workflows`. Restoring an archived definition there requires a deliberate repository change and review of its old source pins and release-publishing behavior.

This archive does not delete workflow-run history, logs, artifacts, releases, tags, or copies on other branches.
